items.note: The PRD says it is written for a generic SaaS app because it has no product details. It never mentions note-taking or B2B notes, and it talks about generic 'resources'.
It is written as a long general PRD. Nothing frames it for engineering and design leads or for a kickoff.

Creating a workspace and inviting by email are covered. 'Shared notes' never appears, only generic shared resources, and v1 also takes on a lot more, such as billing, the audit log and resource moves.
It defines four roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer) plus a Guest persona. v1 was meant to have only admin and member.
SSO is listed as out of scope. Billing is a core v1 goal and requirement (FR-18 to FR-20, M3), not out of scope. Guest access is included through the Viewer/Guest role and is never excluded.
The metric is '% of active accounts in a workspace with 2+ members, 20% within 6 months'. The requested metric was 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days.
It has 14 sections with many tables and would run well past 2 pages.
Migration of existing shared notes is not an open question. Instead the PRD includes a detailed migration plan (section 9) and a migration goal.
